title: Area and Security Lighting Rental Billing Note: Rental Lines while a Light Is Out, at an Electric Service by Rate Schedule Restore
content:
**Billing note.** Where an Area and Security Lighting Rental light is rented on an idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule account, area light rental lines billed while the light was out of use are held back from the restore payment. The rental's status and dates are read from the lighting rental record of the same service account; the lines are the area light rental program charge lines on the service account.

| Area light rented on the account | Rental lines held back from the restore payment |
|---|---|
| Out of service | The area light rental lines dated less than one more than the whole months elapsed since its out-of-service date |
| Removal pending | The area light rental lines dated less than one more than the whole months elapsed since its removal request |
| Any other status, or no light rented | None |

The lines held back are taken off the restore payment before that payment is rounded to the cent and held at no less than zero.

### Hypothetical cases ($9.75 monthly rental)

| Rental record | Whole months elapsed | Lines held back |
|---|---|---|
| Out of service for 3 whole months and some days | 3 | Rental lines dated less than 4 whole months before the current date — four lines, $39.00 |
| Removal requested 1 whole month and some days ago | 1 | Rental lines dated less than 2 whole months before the current date — two lines, $19.50 |
| Active | — | None |
